name: Detektivnaja istorija Dzhejn
source:
Feel like a detective and investigate the mysterious events in the house:
- Make choices that will determine the end
- Build romantic relationships with characters
- Make friends or enemies
- Find the murder

You will play as a character named Jane. She lives the life of an ordinary high school student until strange things start to happen to her… 

Can Jane solve all the secrets, find love and herself? Everything depends only on you!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240106083701/https://stacystorygames.itch.io/janes-mystery-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
感觉像一名侦探，调查房子里的神秘事件：
- 做出决定结局的选择
- 与角色建立浪漫关系
- 结交朋友或敌人
- 找到谋杀案

你将扮演一个名叫简的角色。她过着普通高中生的生活，直到奇怪的事情开始发生在她身上…… 

简能解开所有的秘密，找到爱情和自己吗？一切都只取决于你！

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240106083701/https://stacystorygames.itch.io/janes-mystery-story]Itch.io[/url]]
